name: Fried Liver Attack — Black Tactics
description: 4 tactical challenges for Black in the Fried Liver Attack. Find the precise defensive and counter-attacking sequences to keep the extra piece and survive White's assault!

drills.name: King Escape to d6
drills.description: Black to play. After 8.Nc3, play 8...Nb4 — White deviates with 9.Bb3 instead of 9.O-O.
drills.explanation: Black to move. No forced tactic exists here, but Qf3+ is clearly the strongest continuation. Line: 1. Qf3+ Ke6 2. Nc3 Nb4 3. Bb3. Stockfish 18 (depth 16) evaluates the result at +0.95 for Black, 2.76 pawns better than the next-best alternative.
